scope: Meeting, video, scheduling, office reservation changes, appointment-to-claim linkage, and draft Provider Update preview
release_assessment: Suitable for a controlled release of the verified improvements. Not a blanket production launch certification.

integration.workspace: isolated worktree; unrelated local changes excluded

findings_fixed: Public openings now subtract app-only personal events, focus/schedule holds, indirect-service blocks and attended meetings even without Google sync.
Availability queries use the actual UTC boundaries of the local week, including daylight-saving changes.
Canonical appointment creates and time/provider changes recheck app appointments and local calendar blocks; concurrent appointment writes use the provider selection lock.
Stale appointment edits are rejected before overwriting another scheduling change.
Provider Update administrator access requires the admin/support role and agency membership, except global superadmins.
Provider Update drafts cannot be released through ordinary saves and are excluded from recipient access until sent.

Read-only per-person preview shows real agency-scoped office assignments, license fields, supervision totals and current compensation category/level/rates without generating tokens, signature tasks, messages or time entries.
Tax-ID settings tests now verify an empty edit field rather than requiring plaintext identifiers to be reloaded.
Supervision scheduler test now renders its workspace wrapper and verifies monthly recurrence and selected reminders.

workflow_review.flow: Assigned or booked office hours; unbook, partial release and future forfeiture
workflow_review.evidence: officeRelease, officePlanLimits, officePublishedAvailability and officeMoveApproval regression suites; MySQL move/rollback tests
workflow_review.behavior: Preserves original reservation pending approval and protects appointment/clinical links; occurrence release retains recurring assignment.

workflow_review.evidence: publicAvailability, agencyAvailability, availabilityWorkspace, publicationEdits, publicTranslation suites
workflow_review.behavior: Explicit publications remain distinct from client appointments; provider-wide blockers subtract from both modalities.

workflow_review.flow: Personal events, holds, focus and indirect blocks
workflow_review.evidence: calendarBusy tests and four local-calendar availability regressions
workflow_review.behavior: Busy even when Google is unavailable; private event contents do not appear in public diagnostics.

workflow_review.flow: Client appointment and recurring session booking
workflow_review.evidence: officeBinding, clinicalLink, recurrence, appointmentWriteGuard, scheduling.mysql suites
workflow_review.behavior: Canonical IDs persist through office moves; signed documentation and completed encounters are protected.

workflow_review.evidence: 155 claim tests including isolated SQL planned-encounter retry/concurrency test
workflow_review.behavior: Unsigned/nonbillable/mismatched notes, non-occurring appointments and self-pay-only encounters block insurance claims; planned imports do not manufacture notes or claims.

validation.mysql_runtime: Disposable task-owned localhost MySQL 9.5 on port 33328; synthetic data only

broader_frontend.comparison: Remaining failures reproduced on original main source, including one suite blocked by missing DOMMatrix in its test environment. Existing public-directory, family and shared UI tests still need separate follow-up.

limits: No claim was submitted to a clearinghouse or payer; real enrollment, credentials, routing and acceptance are not proven by these local checks.
No full live multi-user browser matrix or video/headset/network-loss session was run during this release audit.
Concurrency evidence covers canonical appointment writes and public selection locking; it is not proof that every legacy calendar writer shares the same lock.
A cross-database clinical synchronization failure after a committed office move remains an explicit recoverable error, not a distributed transaction.
One-occurrence office moves remain limited to one hourly slot; recurring blocks support multi-hour moves.
Per-person amendment preview uses current profile compensation; final amendment wording and proposed individual terms remain draft.

provider_update.entry: Admin → Provider Update → Compose → Preview full → Preview as

data_context: Earlier cleanup evidence applies to the connected onboarding_stage database only; no new production-data cleanup was performed in this turn.
